Um dos principais focos da NanoBrasil no: One of NanoBrasil's main focuses in Brazil: bringing antimicrobial nanoparticles to the poultry sector.
A cama aviária reúne umidade, matéria or: Poultry litter gathers moisture, organic matter and microorganisms throughout the whole rearing cycle, and it is one of the main sources of flock contamination. Copper nanoparticles act as antimicrobial agents: in contact with bacteria and fungi, they damage their structures and reduce the microbial load of the environment. Because they are much smaller, they have more contact area and can work with a smaller amount of active ingredient.
A pesquisa científica também aponta as n: Scientific research also points to metallic nanoparticles as a promising alternative for poultry production, at a time when the industry seeks to use fewer antibiotics and is concerned about microbial resistance. NanoBrasil develops and supplies these stabilized, standardized nanoparticles, ready to be incorporated into products for the sector.

Nanopartículas de dióxido de titânio e n: Titanium dioxide nanoparticles and calcium carbonate nanoparticles
A nanotecnologia aplicada a tintas e rev: Nanotechnology applied to paints and coatings uses copper and zinc oxide nanoparticles as antimicrobial agents, inhibiting bacteria and fungi and ensuring safer, more durable surfaces. In addition, titanium dioxide nanoparticles help improve coatings and can replace silver in different applications, reducing costs and increasing the durability and performance of paints, especially powder coatings.
Em tintas e revestimentos, o desempenho: In paints and coatings, performance depends on how the particle is distributed in the formulation. At the nanoscale, particles have much more contact area with the resin, which favors dispersion, finish and the action of the active ingredient on the surface. Titanium dioxide is known for protecting against UV radiation and, under light, can have photocatalytic action, which contributes to self-cleaning surfaces and to the inhibition of microorganisms. Nanoscale calcium carbonate acts as a functional filler, improving properties such as resistance and finish.

In pharmaceuticals, nanotechnology additives increase absorption and reduce digestive losses. These innovations combine efficiency, safety and long-lasting action, expanding the possibilities in home, personal and therapeutic care with nanometric precision.

Como a NanoBrasil coleta, usa, armazena: How NanoBrasil collects, uses, stores and protects the personal data of people who contact us, and how to request deletion of your data.
Como a NanoBrasil trata os dados pessoai: How NanoBrasil handles the personal data you share with us.
Esta política explica como a NanoBrasil: This policy explains how NanoBrasil handles the personal data of people who visit this website and of those who contact us, in line with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018, the LGPD).
Quem é o responsável pelos dados: Who is responsible for the data
A NanoBrasil, sediada no Parque Tecnológ: NanoBrasil, based at Parque Tecnológico de Belo Horizonte (BH-TEC), in Belo Horizonte - MG, is the controller of the personal data processed through this website. Address: Rua Professor José Vieira de Mendonça, 770, Engenho Nogueira, Sala 411, CEP 31.310-260.
Coletamos somente o que você nos informa: We only collect what you give us when you fill in the contact form or write to us:
a área de interesse (pesquisa, nanopartí: your area of interest (research, nanoparticles or consulting);
o conteúdo da mensagem, como o desafio d: the content of your message, such as your industry challenge or the products you want a quote for.
Não pedimos dados sensíveis, documentos: We do not ask for sensitive data, personal documents or payment information through this website.
Para que usamos os dados: What we use the data for
Ao enviar um formulário solicitando cota: When you submit a form requesting a quote or contact, NanoBrasil stores your data in order to get in touch with you. We use this information to:
responder à sua mensagem e entender a su: answer your message and understand your needs;
enviar cotações, propostas, amostras e i: send quotes, proposals, samples and technical information about nanoparticles and research projects;
manter o histórico do atendimento e da r: keep a record of our service and business relationship;
cumprir obrigações legais e regulatórias: comply with legal and regulatory obligations, where applicable.
Não usamos os seus dados para decisões a: We do not use your data for automated decision-making and we do not sell it to third parties.
Tratamos os dados com base no seu consen: We process data on the basis of your consent, given when you submit the form, and of the need to carry out preliminary steps related to a contract at your request, such as a quote. In some cases we also rely on NanoBrasil’s legitimate interest in maintaining the business relationship, always respecting your rights.
Como enviamos e armazenamos os dados: How we send and store data
O formulário permite escolher o envio po: The form lets you choose to send your request by email or by WhatsApp. The data reaches NanoBrasil’s sales team through the channel you chose and is stored in our email and customer service systems, with access restricted to the people who need it to respond to you.
Guardamos os dados pelo tempo necessário: We keep the data for as long as needed to handle your request and maintain the business relationship. After that, it is deleted or anonymized, unless the law requires it to be kept for longer.
Não vendemos nem alugamos dados pessoais: We do not sell or rent personal data. We may share it only with providers that make our service possible, such as hosting, email and messaging services, and with authorities where legally required. These providers may only use the data to deliver the contracted service.
Você pode solicitar a exclusão dos seus: You can request the deletion of your data at any time. Just write to the email address given at the end of this page. In addition, the LGPD gives you the right to:
confirmar que tratamos dados seus e aces: confirm that we process your data and access it;
corrigir dados incompletos, inexatos ou: correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data;
pedir a anonimização, o bloqueio ou a el: request anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data or data processed unlawfully;
receber os seus dados em formato estrutu: receive your data in a structured format (portability);
saber com quem compartilhamos os seus da: know with whom we share your data;
revogar o consentimento a qualquer momen: withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting processing already carried out.
Respondemos às solicitações em até 15 di: We respond to requests within 15 days. If you prefer, you can also file a complaint with the Brazilian National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).
Adotamos medidas técnicas e organizacion: We adopt technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, loss and misuse. No system is completely free from failure, so if an incident that could affect you occurs, we will notify you and the ANPD as required by law.
Este site não usa cookies de publicidade: This website does not use advertising cookies. We only use the storage needed for it to work: your language preference, so the site opens in the language you chose, and your choice in the cookie notice. Measurement cookies, if they come to be used, will only be activated with your permission. You can delete this information at any time in your browser settings.
O site contém links para serviços de ter: The website contains links to third-party services, such as WhatsApp, LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram. These services have their own privacy policies, and NanoBrasil is not responsible for the data processing they carry out.
Podemos atualizar esta política para ref: We may update this policy to reflect changes in the law or in our work. The date of the last update appears at the top of the page.
Para exercer seus direitos, pedir a excl: To exercise your rights, request deletion of your data or ask questions about this policy, write to comercial@nanobrasil.net.
